title: Peruvian Fried Rice
description: A simple and flavorful Peruvian-inspired fried rice dish, perfect for a quick weeknight meal.

ingredients.name: Peruvian rice
ingredients.notes: Use leftover rice for best results

ingredients.name: Fried garlic
ingredients.notes: Use leftover garlic for best results

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add cooked rice to the skillet, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Stir in sweetcorn kernels, fried garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly, until the rice is heated through.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
